metadata.title: Model weights and developer toolchains review
metadata.description: Review known locations of downloaded AI model weights and installed language toolchains. Re-downloads can be slow or impossible for gated models, and removing an installed tool breaks the projects that use it.

insights.title: Review Ollama models
insights.subject: model weights
insights.detail: Downloaded model weights, often many gigabytes. Re-pulling costs time and bandwidth. Use the ollama list and ollama rm commands rather than deleting files.

insights.title: Review Hugging Face hub cache
insights.subject: model weights
insights.detail: Downloaded model and dataset snapshots. Gated models need license acceptance again before download. Use the Hugging Face cache tools to inspect entries; the access token sits beside this folder.

insights.title: Review Rust toolchains
insights.subject: toolchains
insights.detail: Installed Rust toolchains and components. Removing one breaks builds that pin it. Use rustup toolchain list and rustup toolchain uninstall for changes.

insights.title: Review Cargo-installed tools
insights.subject: installed tools
insights.detail: Executables installed with cargo install, plus rustup proxies. Removing them breaks commands on your PATH. Use cargo install --list to see what was installed.

insights.title: Review pyenv Python versions
insights.subject: toolchains
insights.detail: Python interpreters installed with pyenv. Virtual environments built on one stop working when it is removed. Use pyenv versions and pyenv uninstall for changes.

insights.title: Review nvm Node.js versions
insights.subject: toolchains
insights.detail: Node.js versions installed by nvm. Global packages belong to each version. Use nvm ls to review and nvm uninstall to change.

insights.title: Review SDKMAN candidates
insights.subject: toolchains
insights.detail: JDKs, build tools and other SDKMAN candidates. Check which projects pin a version, then use sdk list and sdk uninstall for changes.
